notes.title: I Love Finding Critters - Cinco de Mayo Update
notes.content:
In this Cinco de Mayo update, enjoy 2 new beautiful hidden object scenes. Search for a variety of critters and objects while traveling through scenes inspired by [b]Hidalgo [/b]and [b]Jalisco, Mexico[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938734/f34b6f0719fc3407e87fd7734824fe8072a58d3c.jpg[/img]

If you like playing I Love Finding Critters and other hidden object games, you may also like our upcoming game - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823330/Faircrofts_Antiques_The_Mountaineers_Legacy/]Faircroft's Antiques: The Mountaineer’s Legacy[/url]. Add it to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1823330/Faircrofts_Antiques_The_Mountaineers_Legacy/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895640/I_Love_Finding_Critters/

notes.title: Valentine's Update!
notes.content:
Happy Valentine's Day! Celebrate and enjoy these 2 bonus hidden object scenes of I Love Finding MORE Cats!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41509168/807316d60c6d2ef26a666288fa26537a2055945e.png[/img]

If you like I Love Finding MORE Cats,  you will also love [b]Threaded[/b]! It is a beautiful relaxing new twist on pixel art puzzles. 

You can get it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767190/Threaded/

We also recently launched a classic hidden object game, 
[b]Faircroft's Antiques: The Forbidden Crypt[/b]! Search through gorgeously rendered locations, breathe new life into a collection of antiques, and discover the secret that lies in the crypt of Porto Nacosti!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1721690/Faircrofts_Antiques_The_Forbidden_Crypt/

Coming Soon: [b]First time in Paris[/b]! In this hidden object game, join amateur travel blogger Kate Robinson and her daughter Nicole as they go on their first big business trip to save a Parisian hotel!

Add First Time in Paris to your wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1767150/First_Time_in_Paris/
